title: Run an initialize preflight recipe before work
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, and works with the `initialize_preflight` recipe. Fangore starts substantive graphs only after the initialize/preflight Agentic Recipe completes linkage, capability, and checkpoint checks. Accepts WalkingLabs L06 guidance. He walks product steps (instantiate_recipe) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^wl-l06-init]

validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `initialize_preflight_template.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
